'''2014 MPC Holotable Cole Lepine DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Holotable).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Holotable
